text:
samira: Heads up — autoscaling in asia-south1 didn't fire during the GPU degradation window. Cluster had spare pods but HPA metrics were 0 for ~7m. Noticed missing 'autoscaler' Prometheus series.
jorge: :thinking: did we lose the scrape endpoints or the metrics pipeline?
samira: looks like both. kube-state-metrics targets were up but Prometheus shows `no data` for autoscaler.* series, and traces from the batcher aren't arriving.
infra-bot: Alert: region=asia-south1 high_gpu_wait_time 3m, telemetry_sink_errors increased by 1.2k.
mara: any network ACL changes around 03:20 UTC? That could block OTLP egress to the aggregator.
max: checking VPC logs now. I see a brief routing flap from our NAT cluster at 03:17 — several connections to observability-agg-api timed out.
leah: that would explain missing metrics + traces. If the otel-collector couldn't reach the central sink, metrics buffered locally then dropped once the queue filled.
samira: we still have local logs on the nodes; fluentd shows backpressure and "exporter_write_failed" spikes.
ops-shift: workaround plan: 1) failover collector to regional aggregator 2) restart otel collectors to flush queues 3) re-enable HPA metrics scraping.
jorge: I pushed a failover to regional-agg.asia-south1.internal for OTLP in the DaemonSet config. Patch applied:
```
- otlp.endpoint: "https://observability.global-agg:4317"
+ otlp.endpoint: "https://regional-agg.asia-south1:4317"
  otlp.retry.enabled: true
  otlp.queue_size: 20000
```
max: rolling restart command: `kubectl -n observability rollout restart ds/otel-collector` — starting now.
mara: also increased Prometheus scrape_timeout for the autoscaler job from 10s -> 20s to tolerate transient latency spikes.
leah: ran `kubectl get pods -n monitoring -l job=kube-state-metrics` and restarted the pod that had OOM restarts. That pod wasn't serving `/metrics` for ~6m.
samira: after the restart and failover, HPA metrics started returning at 03:31 and a scale-up began at 03:33.
infra-bot: Incident note: telemetry pipeline degraded 03:16-03:32 UTC. Root cause: transient NAT routing flap + insufficient local buffer for OTLP exporter.
ops-shift: follow-ups: add a regional aggregator as failover in all DaemonSets, add alert if exporter queue > 80%, and add a synthetic scrape every minute to detect silent `/metrics` failures.
jorge: I'll open a PR with the config changes (buffering + failover endpoints) and a runbook update for on-call to include `kubectl -n observability logs ds/otel-collector` checks.
mara: also logging note — add a tag to trace spans that denote regional-agg endpoint so we can correlate outages.
samira: thanks team. I'm going to run a postmortem draft with timeline + cost impact (we had extra transient on-demand GPUs while autoscaling lagged).
leah: cost note: estimate ~0.4 GPU-hours extra during 17m of degraded scaling window.
ops-shift: closing the incident channel when PR and runbook are in. Good work. :thumbsup:
